text:
Mina: Morning mystery: the office kettle has a tiny paper crown on it. Who crowned the tea appliance? :crown:
Owen: guilty. Meet Baron Boil. He has presided over many team standups.
Doorman Dan: I officially recognize Baron Boil. New duty: boil with dignity and announce when water hits a noble whistle. Also accepts granola bribes.
Luca: can we have a tea blessing ritual? One clap, a tiny bow, and a nod to the Baron before pouring. Mandatory for loose-leaf.
Mina: love it. also suggesting a tiny laminated plaque: "Baron Boil, Keeper of Warmth." low-effort morale.
Owen: ops-bot, poll? Plaque / Crown upgrade / Nothing.
ops-bot: Poll created: "Baron Boil merch" Options: Plaque / Crown upgrade / Nothing. React to vote.
extra: Mina voted Plaque. Owen voted Crown upgrade. Doorman Dan voted Plaque. ops-bot: reminder scheduled: poll closes in 24h. Photo uploaded to #random-photos: https://files.redwood/baron_boil.jpg
